WEHD: Lahia = took down. Sirjanhaar = by the Creator, by Kartar.
O brother! The Guru, the Creator (Himself), has taken down (the child Hargobind's) fever.
Through the Guru, the Creator Lord has subdued the fever.
The Guru-Creator has rid me of my fever.
The True Guru, the Creator, who has (lahia) taken down Sri Guru Hargobind Sahib ji's fever —
GLP3: Kau = to. Bal jaee = I am a sacrifice. Jin = which (Guru). Paij = honour. Sansar = in the world. ||1|| Rahau ||
I am forever a sacrifice to my Guru, who has kept (my) honour in the whole world (otherwise the superstitious kept urging worship of the goddess Seetla and the like). ||1|| Rahau ||
I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has saved the honor of the whole world. ||1||Pause||
I am a sacrifice to my rue Guru, who has preserved the honour of the whole world. Pause.
to that True Guru of mine I am forever a sacrifice, and who has kept our honour in the whole world. ||1|| Rahau ||
3GWN: Kar = hand. Mastak = on the forehead. Dhar = placing. Rakh leen = has saved (from the fever).
O brother! Placing His hand on (the child's) head, Prabhu saved the child (from the fever).
Placing His Hand on the child's forehead, He saved him.
Placing his hand on the forehead, the Guru has saved the child.
Placing His hand on the forehead, He has saved His child.
TC58: Prabh = by Prabhu. Amrit = giving spiritual life. Maha ras = most delicious. Deenho = {there is a half 'h' under the letter 'n'}. ||1||
(He saved him not only from the fever, but from other worship too:) Prabhu has also given His Name, which gives spiritual life and is the finest of all tastes. ||1||
God blessed me with the supreme, sublime essence of the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||
The Lord has blessed me with the great elixir of His Immortalising Name.
Prabhu has given us the Name, the nectar, the great taste. ||1||
SAM3: The merciful Prabhu (surely) keeps His servant's honour (so, O brother, don't panic in times of pain and trouble and go looking for other supports).
The Merciful Lord saves the honor of His slave.
The Merciful Master saves the honour of His servant.
That (miharvan) merciful Vahiguru Himself keeps His servant's honour.
LLVP: (O brother! Remember:) Guru Nanak speaks (only what is) accepted in (Parmatma's) court. ||2||6||86||
Guru Nanak speaks - it is confirmed in the Court of the Lord. ||2||6||86||
Whatever Guru Nanak utters, that is approved in the Lord's court.
Sri Guru ji says: those who, through the Guru, (bolai) speak His praise are accepted in the (dargah) true company, or in Sach Khand. ||2||6||86||

CGVP: Taap te = from pains and troubles. Rakhe = saves.
O brother! Parmatma Himself saves from all pains, troubles and vices those people
He Himself protects me from suffering and sin.
From sufferings and sins, the Lord Himself protects me.
Vahiguru Himself has saved us from (taap) suffering and from sins.
EDPY: — their hearts become cool and calm who fall at the Guru's feet and chant Parmatma's Name in their heart. ||1|| Rahau ||
Falling at the Guru's Feet, I am cooled and soothed; I meditate on the Lord's Name within my heart. ||1||Pause||
Repairing to the Guru's feet and contemplating the Lord's Name within my mind, I am tranquilised. Pause.
By falling at the Guru's feet we have become cool, because we have chanted the chant of Ram's Name in our heart. ||1|| Rahau ||
D7DP: Kar = showing. Hasat = hands. Prabh = by Prabhu. Jagat udhar = the One who carries the whole world across. Nav khand = in the nine regions, in the whole world. Partaap = radiance.

(O brother! Those who take the Guru's shelter and chant Prabhu's Name —) Prabhu, in His kindness, has always placed His hands (on their heads). That Prabhu carries the whole world across; His radiance shines through the whole world.
Granting His Mercy, God has extended His Hands. He is the Emancipator of the World; His glorious radiance pervades the nine continents.
Showing His benediction, the Lord has shielded me with His hands. He glory is manifest in the nine continents and He is the Emancipator of the World.
In His grace, Prabhu has placed His lotus hands on our forehead and has saved us from the world. From that our glory has spread through the nine regions — He whose glory fills the nine regions.
GKX6: Sach = Hari's everlasting Name. Dhrap = are satisfied. ||1||

(For those who remember,) all suffering is destroyed and comfort and bliss come to dwell in their hearts; chanting the everlasting Name of Hari their craving is wiped out, their mind is satisfied, and their body (their senses) is satisfied. ||1||
My pain has been dispelled, and peace and pleasure have come; my desire is quenched, and my mind and body are truly satisfied. ||1||
My affliction is past, my desire is quenched, peace and pleasure have entered my mind and my soul and body are all sated.

So the suffering of birth, death and the rest has been destroyed, and the bliss of the form of peace has come into the heart. And our fire of craving has been put out, and our mind and body, having found the True One, are (dhrap) satisfied. ||1||
CDJM: Ko = of. Naath = master. Saran samartha = able to help those who take shelter.
O Nanak! Parmatma is the Master of the masterless, able to help those who come to His shelter, the mother and father of all creation.
He is the Master of the masterless, All-powerful to give Sanctuary. He is the Mother and Father of the whole Universe.
The Lord is the Master of the masterless and potent to give refuge. He is the Father and Mother of entire creation.
He is the Master of the masterless, the able protector of those who take shelter, and, being mother and father of all creation, He sustains it.
F9HE: Bhagat vachhal = loving devotion. Bhai bhanjan = destroyer of all fears. Alaap = speak, recite. ||2||20||106||
That Master Prabhu loves devotion and takes away all fear; keep chanting His Name, singing His virtues. ||2||20||106||
He is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear; Nanak sings and chants the Glorious Praises of his Lord and Master. ||2||20||106||
He is the Lover of devotional service and the Destroyer of dread, Nanak sings and utters his Lord's praise.

He is the (vachhal) beloved of His devotees, the Master who takes away all fear. Sri Guru ji says: we sing His virtues, setting them in raags. ||2||20||106|| ☬ Through meeting the Guru and chanting the Name, he speaks of what he has gained:
